checks.name: Reject invalid instruction and bounds before preparing or applying
All five adapter operations map to exact bounded velocities
Reject mismatch, malicious action fields, nonfinite duration and wrong provenance
Exact captured image hash is required before issuing a move
Stationary model choice freezes and finishes without motion
Waiting is frozen and exact simulation deadline stops a single move
Every subsequent move gets a new frame after previous simulated action
Thirty maximum actions stop at60 simulated seconds
Cancelled request cannot move even if transport ignores AbortSignal
Cancellation during delayed controller preparation prevents capture and side effects
New session replaces old deferred response without freezing its movement
Body/session change invalidates a pending result
Body/session change stops an active action
Reset simulation clock cannot prolong action
Offline and malformed responses freeze without fallback
Timeout aborts transport and ignores late valid output
Snapshot excludes pixels, copies history, and dispose invalidates pending response
New body/pose clears previous decisions and makes pending responses inert
Environment goal completion freezes early and records actual movement duration
Environment completion invalidates an in-flight proposal
Real Flower MuJoCo and ONNX execute then freeze at bounded deadlines

limitations: Cancellation checks exercise the production vision arbiter with injected engine callbacks; they do not execute draft-lab.js DOM event handlers or asynchronous model loading.
Camera bytes in this harness are synthetic. Real rendering, service transport and VLM choices require separate live browser evidence.
